d: Short, platinum white hair with choppy bangs and a single long, thick braid draped over the shoulder. Sharp, narrow crimson eyes with a focused expression on a youthful, adolescent face. A slender build wearing a black beanie with a white rabbit emblem, a red scarf wrapped around the lower face, a black pleated skirt, and a long, tattered black coat with a red lining. Accessories include black combat boots, a white bandage on the right thigh, and a black tactical glove on the right hand holding a dark blade.
